question: Who Owns Whataburger?
quick_answer: Whataburger is majority-owned by BDT & MSD Partners (formerly BDT Capital Partners), a Chicago-based merchant bank that bought a controlling stake from the founding Dobson family in 2019. The Dobson family kept a minority stake, and the headquarters stays in San Antonio, Texas. Whataburger was founded in 1950 in Corpus Christi, Texas.

Founding Dobson family retains a minority stake

body.heading: Who owns Whataburger now?
body.text: Whataburger is controlled by BDT & MSD Partners, a Chicago merchant bank (previously named BDT Capital Partners). In 2019 the founding Dobson family sold a majority stake to BDT, ending roughly seven decades of full family ownership. The family kept a minority stake and the brand stayed Texas-headquartered.

body.heading: From a Texas stand to a Southern icon
body.text: Whataburger was founded in 1950 in Corpus Christi, Texas, by Harmon Dobson and Paul Burton. It grew into a beloved Southern chain known for its orange-and-white A-frame buildings, made-to-order burgers on a five-inch bun, and being open around the clock. The 2019 investment was aimed at funding faster growth.

body.heading: What the sale changed
body.text: For customers, Whataburger's menu and its Texas identity stayed the same after the 2019 deal. The new majority owner brought capital to expand Whataburger beyond its traditional Texas-and-South base into new states, which is why you now see it opening in markets where it was never available before.

faqs.a: Only partly. The founding Dobson family sold a majority stake to BDT Capital Partners (now BDT & MSD Partners) in 2019 and kept a minority stake. The majority owner is now the investment firm.
Whataburger is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, and it kept its Texas base after the 2019 majority-stake sale.
